criterion: signature/rename whose call sites are not all updated
finding: `resolve worktreeBasePath` now exits 2, but the `/afk:setup` H6 probe in skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md still calls it, so H6 can never pass
why: The H6 probe (MANIFEST.md:149 `keys="worktreeBasePath"`, :160-162 `for k in $keys; do "$PY" "$AC" resolve "$k" >/dev/null 2>&1 || m="$m $k"`) now records `unresolved: worktreeBasePath` and exits 1 on every repository. Neither D-40 nor D-43 names this caller (D-43 defers only the CONFIG.md sentence; D-40 only mentions developer_values.py). I grepped non-doc files for `resolve.*worktreeBasePath`: this probe is the only live caller outside the creator.
fix: Change the H6 probe to resolve only keys that still resolve (drop `worktreeBasePath` from `keys`), or record the MANIFEST H6 edit in D-43's hand-off to 0010-setup-walk and keep `resolve worktreeBasePath` answering with the derived value until then.
evidence: scripts/afk-config.py:1482-1485 `if key == "worktreeBasePath": sys.stderr.write("afk-config: `resolve worktreeBasePath` is gone; ...") return 2`; skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md:161 `"$PY" "$AC" resolve "$k" >/dev/null 2>&1 || m="$m $k"`; SDD §3 row `afk-config.py resolve worktreeRoot`: "callers move in the same commit"; plan 0005 Acceptance: "every caller ... moved in the same commit"

criterion: Acceptance: every agent route that creates a worktree of a listed repository lands it at <root>/<short name>/<name> (AC-050); creator runs every check before anything is made (ADR-0002)
finding: A listed repository's --branch --dir with a '..' dir name is refused by placement (rule 'outside') but the creator ignores that verdict and cuts the worktree outside <root>/<short name>
why: place() lets state=refused/rule=outside fall through for the name and dir modes, so the else-branch at line 362 sets WORKTREE_PARENT=$P_FOLDER and line 379 builds DEST=$WORKTREE_PARENT/$DIR_NAME with the unchecked --dir (only --name is validated by valid_name, line 209), landing <root>/<short>/../x, i.e. directly under <root>; the 'outside' refusal is only acted on in parent mode (line 350 onward).
fix: In place(), treat refused/outside as a refusal for the name and dir modes too (exit 3 with the 'outside' line), or validate --dir with valid_name; add a creator test for a listed repository with --dir ../escape asserting exit 3 and nothing made.
evidence: line 332: `[[ "$P_STATE" != refused || "$P_RULE" == outside || "$P_RULE" == main ]] || refuse_exit "worktree root: ..."`; scripts/placement.py:273-274 returns `Verdict(REFUSED, target, base, OUTSIDE, f"{target} is outside {base}")` for target_for(folder, "../x"); create-worktree line 379 `DEST="$WORKTREE_PARENT/$DIR_NAME"` with DIR_NAME unvalidated in branch mode (lines 212-214)

finding: Caller-set ledger for the creator/h2_move surface is verdict `partial`, not closed or closed-with-frontier
why: The B1 universe excludes docs/afk/*/investigations/** (28394 hits, past the 20000 ceiling), so the caller set is not proven closed by the required standard; I could only cross-check the live callers by hand (hooks/worktree-create.sh:26, scripts/afk-launch.py:57-62, scripts/afk-move.py:109-116, hooks/lib/protected_branch_guard.py:451-457, skills settle-change/execute/bug), and found no broken caller.

evidence: "verdict": "partial"; B1 "status": "partial", "reason": "universe excludes docs/afk/*/investigations/**: the whole-tree pass returns 28394 hits, past the 20000 ceiling"

finding: Parent mode serialises all 6 Verdict fields, so a root refusal prints a corrupted ERROR line
why: check_target returns the 6-field Verdict (the trailing `warnings` tuple), but `place` reads 5 fields, so `read` puts reason, 0x1f and the tuple repr in P_REASON.
fix: Return `placement.check_target(value, folder)[:5]` like the other modes do (line 314 uses `verdict[:5]`).
evidence: line 310 `return placement.check_target(value, folder)` vs line 314 `return verdict[:5]`; line 321 joins every field. Failing input: agent session, listed repository, `--branch b --dir d --base dev --parent /tmp/x` with `developer.worktreeRoot: relative/root`. The exit is 3 but the line reads `ERROR=worktree root: R-01 relative/root is not an absolute path<0x1f>() - run /afk:setup`. With R-04 warnings the tuple repr of Finding(...) is embedded. The tests only cover the `outside` rule in this mode, which ignores P_REASON.

finding: No test that --name ignores --parent (the agent bypass case)
why: The new header says '--parent is ignored' with --name and the code skips the parent block when NAME is set, but an agent --name run with --parent outside <root>/<short name> is never exercised, so a regression would let an agent place a worktree outside the root unnoticed.
fix: Add a listed-repo test: --name n --parent <outside> (agent) lands at <root>/<short name>/n and nothing is made at the outside path.
evidence: create-worktree header: "directory. --parent is ignored."; code `if [[ -z "$NAME" && -n "$WORKTREE_PARENT" ]]`; grep of scripts/tests for '--name' with '--parent' in one call finds nothing

finding: Possible weak oracle: every AC-060 case only compares the outside twin with the inside twin; none asserts a baseline result
why: A hook, gate or script that fails or denies identically on both twins (same rc and same normalised stderr) passes, so the test proves parity, not that the member works on an outside worktree.
fix: Add an anchor per case family (e.g. expected rc 0 or an expected deny on the protected twins, an expected non-empty marker) so a shared failure is red.

criterion: changed defaults or control flow in an existing check
finding: The existing-destination check changed from `-d` to `-e`, so a plain file at the destination is now refused for every caller
why: This widens a pre-existing guard in a shared script outside the placement change, and no test pins the file-at-destination case; the effect is harmless (git would also fail) but it is unrecorded.
fix: Keep `-d` or add a one-line test and a decision note for the widened check.
evidence: -[[ ! -d "$DEST" ]] || error_exit "worktree ...already exists at $DEST"  /  +[[ ! -e "$DEST" ]] || error_exit "worktree ...already exists at $DEST"

finding: `mkdir -p "$WORKTREE_PARENT"` makes a short-name folder with no marker, and the next creation is then refused by R-06
why: If <root>/<short name> is missing (listed repository, folder deleted by hand), R-06 passes because the folder does not exist, the creator makes it unmarked, and the next run sees a non-empty unmarked folder.
fix: Have the creator make the folder through repo_list (which writes the marker), or refuse with a `run /afk:setup` line when the short-name folder is missing.
evidence: scripts/placement.py:161-173: `held is None` and folder not empty -> `was not made by setup for ...`; create-worktree:576 `mkdir -p "$WORKTREE_PARENT"` (the marker is written only by repo_list.add_repository, scripts/repo_list.py:149 `_claim_folder`). Failing input: add_repository, `rm -rf <root>/proj`, create --name a (exit 0), then create --name b gives exit 3 R-06. Reachability not run, found by reading.
